waypoints.name: Andrews Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: The drive is easy and entirely paved: from Winthrop, head north up the Chewuch River valley on West Chewuch Road / FR-51, about 23 miles to the Andrews Creek Trailhead at roughly 3,040 ft, where Andrews Creek Trail #504 begins. Fill out the free self-issue wilderness permit at the trailhead and leave a trailhead parking pass on the car. Day one is a 17 to 20 mile hike to Upper Cathedral Lake, so get here early — this is the start of a two to four day backpack rather than a day approach.
